title: Early idea: a shop-floor app for logging tool wear, not validated yet
summary: A weak, unvalidated idea — intentionally little UI. One question and a short note on what evidence would earn more page.

blocks.title: Maybe: a phone app where operators log tool wear at the machine
blocks.body: That is the whole idea so far. No users interviewed. No workflow observed. No reason yet to draw screens.

blocks.title: What would earn more UI
blocks.body: Watch three changeovers. Ask who already tracks inserts today (paper? memory? never?). If nobody feels pain, stop. If they do, the next page can be a tiny worksheet — not a dashboard.
